# Local English spelling assets

Built from official npm packages: nspell 2.1.5, is-buffer 2.0.5, dictionary-en 4.0.0, dictionary-en-gb 3.0.0, esbuild 0.25.12.

The browser bundle is generated with esbuild (ES module, minified) from the unmodified nspell sources and is-buffer dependency. US and GB Hunspell dictionaries are unmodified. License notices are included alongside the files.
